headline: GPT-5.6 rollout surfaces productivity trade-offs in real-world use
body: Users reporting decreased productivity after upgrading from GPT-5.5 to GPT-5.6, with performance concerns emerging across multiple developer communities. For healthcare AI deployments, model version changes require careful validation before clinical integration since subtle efficiency losses can compound across high-volume EHR workflows and decision support systems. Organizations implementing GPT-based tools in clinical settings should establish baseline performance metrics and staged rollout protocols rather than automatic upgrades. This signals the broader vendor landscape challenge: newer models aren't always improvements for specialized healthcare use cases, making backward compatibility and rollback capabilities critical for production environments.
